Its prior all-size pointer experiment was mixed (−8.2%, +29.4%, +5.6%), so this remains unverified. Then test K unrolling proposals, which may cut loop overhead but risk register pressure and have no supporting measurements. Defer data-layout and packing changes because they alter more memory behavior and add tail or allocation risks. The supplied trials are noisy and do not establish causes; the prior streaming-region idea had a severe joint regression, so rank it last.
